name: html-inline-svg-numeric-local-id
description: Materializes an inline SVG whose local definition id is all digits. PHP turns a numeric-string array key into an int, so the document-order id identity pass must treat each id as a string instead of failing the whole page compile; the image keeps its gradient and url(#) reference.

source_reference.notes: Product-neutral fixture: site builders commonly emit purely numeric element ids.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.

input.content: <main><svg width="100" height="100" viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><linearGradient id="12345"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#c33"></stop><stop offset="1" stop-color="#33c"></stop></linearGradient></defs><rect width="100" height="100" fill="url(#12345)"></rect></svg></main>
